no_adcom_quote.quote: This NDA was not taken to an Advisory Committee meeting. Linagliptin is the third drug in the class of DPP4 inhibitors, and our reviews have not identified safety or efficacy concerns or complex regulatory issues requiring input from an external advisory panel.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for TRADJENTA (linagliptin, NDA201280). The Cross-Discipline Team Leader, Summary Review, and Office Director memos all state the application was not taken to a public advisory committee because linagliptin was the third DPP-4 inhibitor (not first-in-class), relied on a well-established efficacy endpoint, used typical diabetes trial designs, and raised no unexpected nonclinical or clinical safety concerns. With no AdComm held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
